facts.text: Texas students who rank in the top 5% of their high school class are admitted to the university automatically, for students entering in summer or fall 2027 and spring 2028.

sources.title: Texas Education Agency: UT Austin automatic admission policy (Dec. 18, 2025)
sources.quote: automatically admit all eligible summer/fall 2027 and spring 2028 freshman applicants who rank within the top 5%

sources.title: UT Austin Admissions: Review & Decision Process

facts.text: The Texas Advance Commitment covers full tuition for Texas students with financial need from families earning up to $100,000, and gives partial help up to $125,000. There's no separate application; filing the FAFSA or TASFA is enough.
